Galapagos_3D (Española point-cloud sample), version 1.
Creators: Matan Yuval; Inti Keith; Franklin Terán; William Bensted-Smith; Wilson Iñiguez.
Institutional research provenance: Charles Darwin Research Station, Charles Darwin Foundation, Galápagos, Ecuador.
Dataset publication metadata: February 23, 2025. Zenodo record created May 22, 2025.
Source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14914807
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).

Associated publication:
Yuval, Matan; Terán, Franklin; Iñiguez, Wilson; Bensted-Smith, William; Keith, Inti. (2025). Spatial Variation in Coral Diversity and Reef Complexity in the Galápagos: Insights from Underwater Photogrammetry and New Data Extraction Methods. Remote Sensing 17(11), 1831. https://doi.org/10.3390/rs17111831

Preview transformation: Orthographic research inspection views of the original Española XYZ+RGB point cloud, rendered with 3-pixel point splats against a neutral background with labels. Original coordinates and colors are retained in the downloaded PLY. No triangle mesh, surface interpolation or new coral geometry was generated. No endorsement by the creators or institutions is implied.

Location: Española, Galápagos, eastern Pacific. Not Caribbean habitat.
Scale: Published methods document 10×10 m plots, known-distance scale bars, and 1 cm point-cloud sampling. The point cloud spans approximately 10×10×1.057 native coordinate units, consistent with meters, but the PLY has no units declaration and absolute target distances were not independently remeasured.
